name: DR Congo (east)
value: FRN–army fighting in Kivus; no major city fallen
summary: Army and Kabila-led FRN keep fighting across North and South Kivu; peace tracks stalled; no major city changes hands
state: An FRN offensive through Kahuzi-Biega National Park took Bulambika and Bunyakiri in Kalehe, South Kivu, around 8 Nov, and the army announced a counteroffensive on 9 Nov; villages in Minembwe, Masisi and Rutshuru keep changing hands (Critical Threats, 11 Nov). Al Jazeera reported on 18 Nov that the Doha and Washington peace tracks have not halted the fighting. The FRN says it does not intend to march on Uvira. No major city has fallen and no interstate fighting is confirmed, so Watch holds.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to North and South Kivu. Displacement and aid access problems tend to worsen as front lines shift.
rubric_hit: Active fighting and stalled peace tracks = Watch; no major city captured

sources.title: Critical Threats — Congo War Security Review, 11 November 2026
Al Jazeera — DR Congo's rival peace efforts fail to halt violence in the east

why: A long war over mineral-rich territory, drawing in Rwanda and threatening a wider Great Lakes conflict.
drivers: M23/AFC advances, Rwanda involvement, peace deals, mineral trade.

rubric.alert: Capture of a major city, or direct interstate fighting.
rubric.watch: Active fighting or a fragile ceasefire.
rubric.normal: Peace agreements holding; no major offensives.
